new_bleeding.what: fresh bright-red blood appears on the omentum/stomach wall below the suture site (absent at 64-66 s); camera also shifts, so part may be revealed rather than new
gutter pool looks larger and fresher red at 84-92 s after suturing; could be the camera re-framing the existing pool

wses-laparoscopic-bleeding-ulcer-repair.summary: After a 3.5 s title card the first surgical frame already holds a dark blood pool in the subhepatic gutter, present throughout the ulcer suturing; fresh red staining appears around 70 s and the pool looks larger near the end, but 2 s sampling cannot separate new blood from re-framing.

new_bleeding.what: after the needle passes, one or two extra small dark-red puncture spots appear beside the cord and the existing spot looks slightly larger

barroso-laparoscopic-inguinal-ring-sutur.summary: Clean preperitoneal inguinal view with one small dark blood spot at a needle puncture visible from the first frame; a couple of tiny puncture spots appear after suturing, otherwise no bleeding.

new_bleeding.what: blood-stained dissection field appears; mostly the camera moving to an already-bloodied area
fresh bright-red blood wells up in the choledochal dissection bed (102-106 s)

kaplan-tlpd-technique-3.summary: Adhesiolysis starts bloodless, then pancreatic/hepatoduodenal dissection with blood staining, char and small pools throughout; clearest fresh bleeding is during the common bile duct dissection around 100-106 s.

new_bleeding.what: vivid red bleeding point at the pancreatic stump/anastomosis at 12 s
dark pool at lower left of the anastomosis looks larger 22-28 s; may be framing

non_laparoscopic_spans.what: external view: drapes, port sites and gloved hand

kaplan-tlpd-technique-6.summary: Anastomosis field with blood-stained stump and small dark pools from the start; a bright bleeding point near 12 s, then a cleaner gastroenterostomy; ends on the outside of the abdomen.

anpol42-tep-hernia-2.summary: TEP dissection with maroon blood staining/bruising of the areolar tissue and a dark charred band present throughout; no visible new bleeding at 2 s sampling.

new_bleeding.what: dark wet blood/clot visible in the slit between mesh leaves; likely existing blood uncovered as the mesh moves rather than new bleeding

anpol42-tep-hernia-4.summary: Mesh placement over a dark red, blood-stained preperitoneal field; from ~72 s the new mesh picks up purple blood stains, and dark blood sits in the cord slit late on, but no clear active bleeding. Last 8 s very dark.

new_bleeding.what: darker blood-stained fat appears as the camera advances; cannot tell from new bleeding

anpol42-tep-recurrent-hernia.summary: Short clip of red muscle and hernia sac with no clear blood for 7 s, then the view moves into a darker blood-stained fatty area in the last two frames.

new_bleeding.what: bright red blood pooling around the cystic pedicle while clamping; colour saturation makes blood vs tissue unreliable

non_laparoscopic_spans.what: entire clip is open surgery (gloved hands, clamps), oversaturated colour

gupta-gallbladder-torsion-cholecystectom.summary: Open cholecystectomy of a torsed gallbladder with blood on gloves and wet red field throughout; heavy red oversaturation makes any onset judgement unreliable.

new_bleeding.what: bright red blood and clot collect in the gallbladder bed/pedicle as it is dissected and grows by 34-40 s

boer-gallbladder-torsion-cholecystectomy.summary: Necrotic dark gallbladder with only a small red area at the neck early on; blood appears in the dissection bed from ~26 s and is clearly more by the end.

new_bleeding.what: blood rivulet runs down the pale abdominal wall from the haemorrhagic omentum at 10 s
trickle seen again and longer with blood gathering at the omental edge (18-22 s); could partly be the camera returning

kavalakat-omental-infarction.summary: Haemorrhagic infarcted omentum with a visible blood trickle down the wall around 10-22 s, then mobilisation and bagging; ends inside the port with blood-smeared sleeve.

new_bleeding.what: blood-stained gauze and red raw surface come into view; camera move, not clearly new
dark blood/clot collects below the sutured site at the duodenum (54-58 s)

kaplan-tlpd-diagnostic-laparoscopy.summary: Bloodless survey of liver and omentum, then blood-stained gauze packing and suturing; a small dark clot at the suture point grows into visible blood below it by 54-58 s.

new_bleeding.what: bright red blood welling during porto-uncinate dissection
large bright red pool in the lower field after specimen bagging; may be existing pool newly in view
fresh red blood on the jejunum/anastomosis and a red pool at left (96-104 s)

kaplan-tlpd-technique-5.summary: Pancreaticoduodenectomy steps in a bloody field: red pool at start, fresh bleeding in the uncinate dissection (~22 s), a pooled field around 50-62 s, and fresh blood on the anastomosis near 96-104 s.

anpol42-tep-hernia-1.summary: Short, heavily red-orange TEP view with vessels and fat and motion blur; no identifiable blood, red tints are tissue colour.

new_bleeding.what: a dark red spot/clot appears at the upper dissection edge; could be revealed by retraction

anpol42-tep-hernia-3.summary: Pale TEP dissection with small maroon stains and bruising present from the start; a small dark red spot appears near 96-100 s but no clear bleeding.

non_laparoscopic_spans.what: lens against tissue / red blur, not interpretable

anpol42-tep-indirect-hernia.summary: Dark red indirect sac dissection with small clots and blood-stained cord throughout; no visible new bleeding, final frame is a smeared lens.

admlsir-real-surgical-smoke-D-V09.summary: 4 s robotic cautery of a fat pedicle with smoke particles; no blood at any point (0.25 s sampling).
